name: Treatment
duplicates: One feature since 2026-10-19 (owner): Health record's Record treatment, the Medicines feature (the farm's medicine list and its page) and the old Treat deck (ux/archive/workflows.html, wf-treatment) were one job. Ad hoc only: a worker sees a sick pig and treats it. A vaccination is a task, and a planned or prescribed course is Prescription treatment (prescriptions); neither is designed here.

entryPoints.label: A sick pig: its More actions, Health group
Pigs ticked on the walk: Actions
A finding: treat that condition (the condition is fixed on the form)
Not ad hoc: a vaccination task opens this medicine list filtered to Vaccines (the task and its form are the task's)

addsTo.what: Record treatment in the Health group of a pig's Actions
Record treatment in Actions on the ticked pigs
Record treatment on the finding sheet, with that condition fixed
A Medicines row (the farm's medicine list: its brands, and rename and delete what the farm added)

flow: Save: the walk list, with the toast
type a brand with no match
tap Brand for a medicine with no brands yet
type a name with no match
tap a medicine the farm added

notes.purpose: Record medicine actually given, to one pig or many, without implying every pig got the same dose. Shown after picking Amoxicillin: Method (In water) and the unit (g) pre-filled from its last use, the caption Withdrawal period 14 days · until 26 Sep under Medicine, Brand · Optional, Dosage and Unit side by side, Condition and Note.

elements.name: Variant
elements.shows: Record treatment or Record vaccination

states.shows: treat.record-batch: Medicine, Method, Brand, Dosage and Unit; once a dosage is typed, Same for all N pigs · Adjust › (or N adjusted), opening Dose per pig
Titled "Record vaccination", vaccine list only, no condition chip, Save reads "Save". The vaccination task's, not Treatment's: it moves out to the task (owner, 2026-10-19)

elements.name: Dose and row state
elements.shows: Dose (dose · unit mL · mg · g) for all; each pig's dose trailing its row

states.when: Medicine, method, unit or dose missing
states.shows: No text on the rows; a tap on the waiting Save marks the missing fields "Required"

elements.logic: Method: Injection, Oral, Topical, In feed, In water. Picking a medicine fills Method and the unit with the ones it was last given with (features/treat), unless they were set in this draft; Save stores them on the medicine. Condition chip links only to pigs carrying that condition.

elements.name: Brand
elements.shows: An optional PickerField (grey Optional beside the label), after Method

states.shows: Brand Optional, Select; no brand is recorded
Brand and its name, with the edit icon; Clear in the Brand list removes it

elements.logic: A new medicine drops a brand that belonged to the old one. Opens treat.brand.

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Save · N pigs / Save
elements.rule: Waits until medicine, method, unit and a dose above 0 are set (N = the ticked pigs while it waits). No line above it: a tap while it waits marks the empty fields "Required" and scrolls to the first. One treatment record per included pig; logs "Treatment recorded" or "Vaccination recorded"; a task completes on Save. Dead sows are excluded. Returns to the list, the finding, or the pig record.

edge: A task-triggered treatment may prefill the medicine but the user still confirms (the prototype prefills nothing).
rules: Medicines, methods and units should come from farm configuration.
issues: The medicine list is sample data (features/treat); methods and units are a sample list, not farm configuration.
To confirm (product rule, review/inspection-r2.json): is a dose required for every pig, or may a pig be saved without one?
Record treatment from a finding and from the Health group differ only by the fixed condition.

notes.purpose: Amoxicillin with Amoxinsol 50% (its own 2 days), a condition and a note. Brand and Condition are PickerFields and Note a textarea, each labelled with a grey Optional, styled like Medicine and Method. The brand's withdrawal overrides the medicine's default (14 days) because its label differs.

elements.name: Withdrawal
elements.shows: A muted caption: Withdrawal period N days · until <date>, under Medicine or Brand

states.when: The chosen brand has a withdrawal
No brand, or the brand has none
Neither has one, or it is 0

elements.logic: Until = the treatment date (12 Sep in the prototype) + days. Save keeps a copy of the days, the date and the brand's strength on each record, so a later edit of the brand or medicine never changes it.
elements.rule: Banner notice: a condition that follows from the commit, stated before the action it governs (Banner, When); not danger (nothing is destroyed) and not correction (nothing is reviewed).

issues: Brands and withdrawals are sample farm data.

steps.text: Gave in the morning water through the medicator at 2 g per litre. Two sows in C1 drank less than the rest; recheck their appetite tomorrow before feeding and treat again if no better. Tell G.H.

notes.purpose: The Note, about three lines, typed into directly; at most 200 characters (input stops at the limit); the counter appears from 160 ("185 / 200").

elements.name: Counter
elements.rule: Shown from 160 characters; the textarea's maxlength stops input at 200, so nothing is cut afterwards.

notes.purpose: Saving a treatment closes the form onto the walk list, where the record is not visible, so a Toast says what was saved and for whom (design law: Feedback after saving). Held so the gate can see it.

elements.name: Toast
elements.shows: A check on the green; Treatment recorded; 000267
elements.rule: Shows after a treatment or vaccination saves; about 3 seconds; one at a time. Several pigs: N pigs.

screens.name: Record treatment: saved, no connection
screens.zh: 记录治疗：已保存（无网络）

notes.purpose: The same save with no connection: the record is kept on this phone and uploads when connected. Never says uploaded. The header badge carries the state after the toast goes (Data sync). Held so the gate can see it.

elements.name: Toast
elements.shows: No-signal on the ink; Saved on this phone; Uploads when connected · 000267
elements.rule: Shows instead of the done form when the phone has no connection.

notes.purpose: Several pigs, empty: Medicine (its withdrawal caption once chosen), Method, Brand, Dosage and Unit side by side; no Adjust line until a dosage is typed; Condition and Note.

elements.name: Order
elements.shows: Medicine, Method, Brand (optional), Dosage and Unit, the Adjust line; then Condition and Note (optional fields)
elements.rule: What was given comes first (owner, 2026-10-16): one Dose applies to all; a pig's row trails its dose, muted when it follows the shared dose, ink with Own dose when set. The checkbox stays: it takes a pig out, as on every bulk page. Save waits until the shared dose is set or every included pig has its own.

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Save · N pigs
elements.rule: Waits until medicine, method, unit and a dose above 0 are set; a tap while it waits marks the empty fields Required. One treatment record per ticked pig.

elements.logic: Row (navigate: the row law's word + › on the right when the tap acts); the whole row opens Dose per pig.

notes.purpose: Adjust opens it: the 2 pigs of the form, each box pre-filled with the dosage (2.5). Remove pigs (above the list) switches to remove mode. Ear-tag search and Scan at the top.

elements.name: Pig dose box
elements.shows: The pig's dose: the dosage, or its own (adjusted)

states.shows: The dosage as its value, regular; follows the dosage
Ink, bold, Adjusted under it; keeps its value

elements.logic: Values are live: no Save on the page; Back (top left) returns to the form. Remove pigs switches the list into remove mode (custom-doses-remove).

elements.name: Search and Scan
elements.shows: Search ear tag, with Scan beside it
elements.logic: Search narrows the list; Scan jumps to the scanned pig's box (scrolls it into view and focuses it). New: the prototype had no find-and-focus pattern. No camera in the prototype: Scan reads a sample tag (the last pig).

screens.name: Dose per pig: one adjusted
screens.zh: 每头猪的剂量：一头已调整

notes.purpose: 000254 typed to 3: ink, bold, with Adjusted under it; 000267 keeps the dosage. Unadjusted pigs follow a later change of the dosage; adjusted ones keep theirs; clearing a box returns it to the dosage.

elements.name: Pig dose box
elements.shows: The pig's dose: the dosage, or its own (adjusted)

states.shows: The dosage as its value, regular; follows the dosage
Ink, bold, Adjusted under it; keeps its value

elements.logic: Values are live: no Save on the page; Back (top left) returns to the form. Remove pigs switches the list into remove mode (custom-doses-remove).

notes.purpose: An ear tag typed: the list narrows to the matching pig, its box ready.

screens.zh: 每头猪的剂量：移除猪只

notes.purpose: Remove pigs switches the list into remove mode: each pig's dose box gives way to a remove control (×), Done leaves. Removing takes the pig out of the treatment; the last pig has no control.

elements.name: Remove control
elements.shows: × named "Remove 000254"
elements.logic: The platform list's edit mode (a mode switch above the list, a remove control per row, Done to leave), drawn with IconButton (plain); nothing is removed until a row's control is tapped.

issues: "Done" here leaves a mode; the registry's Done applies a picker's choices with its count. To confirm the word.

screens.name: Choose a medicine: recent, then categories
screens.zh: 选择药品：最近使用与分类

notes.purpose: Pick what was given, over the real Record treatment page: search, the farm's recent medicines, then the categories.

elements.name: Recently used
elements.shows: Up to three medicines the farm picked last, under the group label Recently used; no second line

states.when: The farm has recorded a treatment
Nothing recorded yet, or none fits the task
states.shows: The block is absent; the categories lose their label (treat.medicine-picker-first)

elements.logic: Distinct, newest first, any worker, filtered to the task (a vaccination shows vaccines only). A deleted medicine leaves it.

elements.name: Category rows
elements.shows: The fixed category list, the same on every farm: an icon tile, the category, and three examples from the starting list (owner, 2026-10-19, as the conditions first level)
elements.rule: A tap opens the category as a level; the footer Back comes back here, the ✕ closes the picker.

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet. Its default withdrawals are sample values, to be verified against the official withdrawal periods (China: MOA Announcement No. 278 and its updates) before release.
Brands, recent picks and remembered methods are sample farm data.

screens.name: Choose a medicine: no recent picks

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

notes.purpose: One list of the category's medicines; a tap picks one and closes.

elements.name: Medicine row
elements.shows: The medicine's name, no second line

states.shows: Its name in the worker's language

elements.name: Search
elements.shows: Search all options
elements.rule: Searches every category from here; while it has text the head names the root (Medicines). The footer Back goes up to Medicines.

notes.purpose: Results from every category, each with its category as the second line.

elements.name: Result row
elements.shows: Medicine, with its category as meta
elements.logic: Search mixes categories, so the category is what tells two results apart. Matches the English and Chinese names and common other names (PRRS: blue ear; PCV2: circovirus). In a vaccination only vaccines are searched, and the meta is dropped (one category).

elements.name: Vaccine list
elements.shows: One category left, so its diseases are listed at once under the label All, beside Recently used (never the title again) (no one-row category level)
elements.logic: Recents and search are filtered to Vaccines; adding files the new vaccine under Vaccines.

issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.
Vaccination is a task, not an ad hoc treatment (owner, 2026-10-19): its form moves out to the task. This picker stays here only because the task opens the same medicine list, filtered to Vaccines.

notes.purpose: Nothing matches: one card, Add “Cefquinome”, and nothing else.
Name (pre-filled from the search) and Category; the category is set already when the search was typed inside one.

elements.name: Add
elements.shows: Add
elements.rule: Waits until Name and Category are set; a tap while waiting marks them Required. Adding puts the medicine into the farm's list for everyone at once and picks it: the drawer closes on the form.

notes.purpose: The seven categories; one tap sets it and goes back up to Add a medicine.
The brands the farm has used for the chosen medicine (Amoxicillin): one tap sets it and closes.

elements.name: Brand list
elements.shows: The three most recently used brands under Recently used, the rest under Other brands (A to Z); no second line

states.when: The medicine has at most three brands
states.shows: One list, newest first, no label

states.when: No brand used yet for this medicine
states.shows: Search only; typing a name offers Add

elements.logic: Brands belong to a medicine and are shared by the farm; Save moves the brand used to the top. Brand rows have no second line: a strength that matters is in the name (Amoxinsol 15%, Amoxinsol 50%).

issues: Brands are sample farm data.

notes.purpose: A medicine the farm has never recorded a brand for: the search, then ChoiceList's can-add empty state saying what is missing and how to add it. Typing a name gives Add “…”, as on Brand: no match.

elements.name: Empty state
elements.shows: A tag glyph on the tint; No brands for Ceftiofur yet; Type the name on the bottle's label above to add it.
elements.rule: Shown only when the medicine has no brands and nothing is typed. It names the medicine; the search above is the way to add (no separate page, no button).

notes.purpose: A brand not on the list: one card, Add “Moxylan”, and nothing else.

elements.name: Add card
elements.shows: Add “Moxylan”
elements.rule: One tap adds the brand under this medicine for everyone and picks it; the list closes on the form.

notes.purpose: After Add “Moxylan”: the brand is already added and picked; this optional level offers its withdrawal, which overrides the medicine's default ("Uses Amoxicillin's 14 days when empty"), and can be skipped.

elements.name: Add
elements.shows: Add
elements.rule: Never waits: Add with the field empty keeps the medicine's default; the field label names the brand (Moxylan withdrawal (days)). Back goes up to the Brand list (Moxylan ticked), the ✕ closes on the form: either way the brand stays, using the medicine's default.

notes.purpose: The farm's medicine list by category. Reached from Home → Toolbox → Medicines (not built on Home yet).
issues: The Toolbox row on Home is not built (addsTo, added: false).

notes.purpose: A category's medicines, the starting list and the farm's own, one row each.
issues: The categories and medicines are the starting list every farm gets (medicines-catalogue.json): to be checked by a vet.

screens.name: A medicine's sheet (starting list): default withdrawal, brands

notes.purpose: An edit form: the name is the title and read-only, the withdrawal period (days) is the one editable field, prefilled from the starting list, then the brands the farm has used. No Delete. Footer Back + Save (waits until something changes).

elements.name: Default withdrawal
elements.logic: Used on a treatment when no brand is chosen, or the chosen brand has none (the usual case). Save changes it for everyone from the next treatment; records already saved keep their copy.

elements.name: Brands
elements.shows: Each brand, one row, no second line (a strength that matters is in the brand's name)

issues: The default withdrawals in the starting list are sample values, to be verified against the official withdrawal periods (China: MOA Announcement No. 278 and its updates) before release; not authoritative.

screens.name: A medicine the farm added: name, default withdrawal, brands, Delete

notes.purpose: An edit form: Name and Default withdrawal editable, then its brands, then Delete medicine (a navigate Row in its own card, opening a confirm level). Footer Back + Save.
issues: Who may rename and delete is a permissions rule to confirm (the prototype lets anyone).

screens.name: A brand's sheet: name, withdrawal override, Delete

notes.purpose: An edit form: Name and Withdrawal period (days) as fields, then Delete brand (a navigate Row in its own card, opening a confirm level). Footer Back + Save.

elements.name: Withdrawal
elements.shows: 2, with "Uses Amoxicillin's 14 days when empty" under it
elements.logic: The medicine's default is the usual case; a brand overrides it only when its label differs. Empty means the default applies.

elements.name: Name
elements.shows: Amoxinsol 50%
elements.logic: There is no strength field: when strength matters it is part of the name, so a brand sold in two strengths is two entries (Amoxinsol 15%, Amoxinsol 50%).

issues: Brands and their withdrawals are sample farm data.

notes.purpose: Delete brand's confirm level: what happens to past records, then Delete in red.

elements.name: Delete
elements.shows: Delete
elements.rule: Takes the brand off the Brand list and this page; past records keep its name. The same level deletes a farm-added medicine (Delete medicine).
